info.syllabusName: Kỹ thuật nghiệp vụ ngoại thương (Practices of International Trade)
info.description:
﻿
This subject includes the main parts: Introducing the methods for international transactions; introducing the conditions of international trade; bargaining, contracting, and performing foreign contact.   

Chapter 1: Course Introduction

Chapter 2: International Trade terms

Chapter 3: Export price

Chapter 4: Terms in Contract

Chapter 5: International Payment

Chapter 6: Export Document
Chapter 7: Execution of the import-export contracts
